title: Wishes with wish and if only · 表达愿望：wish 与 if only
pattern: wish + past simple (现在)  ·  wish + past perfect (过去)  ·  wish + would + V (希望别人/事物改变)
summary: wish 和 if only 表达与现实相反的愿望：说现在用过去式，说过去用过去完成式，希望别人改变用 would。
explanation: **wish** 和 **if only** 都用来表达“与现实相反的愿望”，中文常说“真希望……”“要是……就好了”。if only 语气更强烈、更带感情，后面的结构与 wish 相同，只是位置不同：I wish I **could** swim. = If only I **could** swim!
**谈论现在做不到的事**，用 wish + 一般过去时：I wish I **knew** the answer.（我真希望知道答案。）be 动词统一用 were：I wish I **were** taller. 这里的过去式并不表示过去，而是表示“与现实不符”。
**谈论过去的遗憾**，用 wish + 过去完成时（had + 过去分词）：I wish I **had listened** to my parents.（我真希望当时听了父母的话。）中文说“当时”，英语就要把 wish 后面的动作推到更早的过去。
**希望别人或事物改变**，用 wish + would + 动词原形：I wish you **would take** this more seriously.（我真希望你能更认真地对待这件事。）注意：如果主语是 I，通常不用 would 表示自己的愿望（不要说 I wish I would…）；但可以说 I wish it would stop raining，表示希望天气改变。
与中文不同，英语的 wish 后面不能直接跟将来时：不要说 I wish it will stop。另外，wish 表示“希望能做到的事”时用 hope：I hope it will stop raining.（我希望雨会停。）两者语气不同，要根据“是否与现实相反”来选择。
mistakes: ✗ I wish I didn't go to the party yesterday. → ✓ I wish I hadn't gone to the party yesterday. 对过去的遗憾要用过去完成式 hadn't gone，不能用 didn't go。
✗ I wish I can speak French. → ✓ I wish I could speak French. 表示现在做不到的愿望，wish 后面要用过去式 could，而不是 can。
✗ I wish it will stop raining. → ✓ I wish it would stop raining. 中文“真希望雨停”容易直译成 will，但 wish 后面应该用 would，而且不能用 will。
✗ I wish I would be taller. → ✓ I wish I were taller. 说自己做不到的事时，wish 后面用 were / could，不用 would。

examples.text: I wish I knew how to play the piano.
examples.note: 现在不会弹，用过去式 knew。

examples.text: I wish I had listened to my parents.
examples.translation: 我真希望当时听了父母的话。
examples.note: 过去的遗憾，用 had + 过去分词。

examples.text: If only it would stop raining!
examples.note: if only 语气更强烈，would 表示希望事情改变。

examples.text: I wish you would take this more seriously.
examples.translation: 我真希望你能更认真地对待这件事。
examples.note: wish + would 表达对他人的不满或期待。

examples.text: She wishes she had not said such a thing to her boss.
examples.translation: 她希望自己没有对老板说那种话。

examples.text: If only we had booked the tickets earlier!
examples.translation: 要是我们早点订票就好了！

examples.text: I wish I were living closer to my family.
examples.translation: 我真希望自己住得离家人近一些。
examples.note: wish 后面的进行时表示现在的状态与愿望相反。

exercises.sentence: I wish I ___ the answer to that question.
exercises.translation: 我真希望知道那个问题的答案。
options: knew
know
would know
have known
exercises.explanation: 表示现在的遗憾用 wish + 过去式 knew。

exercises.sentence: I wish I ___ more time to prepare for the presentation yesterday.
exercises.translation: 我真希望昨天准备演示时有更多时间。
options: have
would have
had
had had
exercises.explanation: yesterday 指过去，wish 后面要用过去完成式 had had（have 的过去分词是 had）。

exercises.sentence: I wish you ___ talking so loudly in the library.
exercises.translation: 我真希望你在图书馆别大声说话。
options: will stop
would stop
stop
to stop
exercises.explanation: 希望别人改变用 wish + would + 动词原形。

exercises.sentence: If only I ___ my passport with me when I flew to Paris.
exercises.translation: 要是我去巴黎时带了护照就好了。
options: had brought
brought
would bring
have brought
exercises.explanation: if only 表达过去的遗憾，要用过去完成式 had brought。

exercises.source: 我真希望我没有在会议上说那句话。
options: I wish I didn't say that at the meeting.
I wish I hadn't said that at the meeting.
I wish I wouldn't say that at the meeting.
I wish I haven't said that at the meeting.
exercises.explanation: 对过去行为的遗憾用 wish + hadn't said。

options: I wish it would snow tomorrow.
I wish it will snow tomorrow.
I wish it snow tomorrow.
I wish it to snow tomorrow.
exercises.explanation: wish 后面不能用 will；表示希望天气等事物有变化时用 would + 动词原形。

exercises.source: 要是我当初没有辞职就好了。
options: If only I didn't quit my job.
If only I haven't quit my job.
If only I wouldn't quit my job.
If only I hadn't quit my job.
exercises.explanation: “当初”指过去，if only 后面用过去完成式 hadn't quit。

options: I wish I had studied harder for the test.
I wish I can speak three languages.
If only I had listened to his advice.
exercises.explanation: wish 表示现在的愿望要用 could，不能用 can，应写成 I wish I could speak three languages。

options: I wish I would be taller.
She wishes she had not missed the train.
We wish we could go to the beach today.
exercises.explanation: 说自己的外貌等状态时，wish 后面用 were，不能用 would：I wish I were taller.

exercises.prompt: 把单词排成正确的句子。
exercises.translation: 我真希望昨晚待在家里。
exercises.explanation: 表示过去的遗憾：wish + 主语 + had + 过去分词。

exercises.prompt: 把单词排成正确的句子。
exercises.translation: 要是她能听我一次就好了。
exercises.explanation: if only 后面接 would + 动词原形，表示希望别人改变。
